decisions.reason: The safety shoe line gained a dedicated page in 2024, indicating growing importance and likely continued investment.
Comfort insole remained only mentioned on the website without a dedicated page, suggesting limited market traction and making it a candidate for discontinuation.
Supportive insole also stayed only mentioned on the website, indicating insufficient demand to justify continued resource allocation.
Ergonomic safety shoe series has had its own page since launch, reflecting strong ongoing support.
Firefighter and rescue boots moved from a mention to a dedicated page, showing positive development and strategic importance.
Moulded insole is featured on the home page and has specific customer success results, making it a high-priority product.
